visual.title: Subtract the hole
visual.caption: The slice is an annulus, not a disk. Its area is the outer disk minus the inner disk, so the radii are squared before subtracting.

predict.question: The area of a washer slice is:
predict.explain: The annulus area is the outer disk minus the inner disk, πR² − πr². Subtracting the radii first would give the wrong shape.
